CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.c3_hardened_pac_immutable_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_context text:=current_setting('c3.pac_registrar_context',true);
begin
  if old.registration_protocol<>'registrar_v1' then
    return new;
  end if;

  if nullif(v_context,'') is null then
    raise exception 'registrar_v1 PAC is immutable; supersede through Registrar';
  end if;

  if (
    new.pac_key is distinct from old.pac_key
    or new.envpac_key is distinct from old.envpac_key
    or new.pac_type is distinct from old.pac_type
    or new.version is distinct from old.version
    or new.standing is distinct from old.standing
    or new.custody_uri is distinct from old.custody_uri
    or new.content_sha256 is distinct from old.content_sha256
    or new.source_authority is distinct from old.source_authority
    or new.metadata is distinct from old.metadata
    or new.schema_key is distinct from old.schema_key
    or new.owner_subject_type is distinct from old.owner_subject_type
    or new.owner_subject_key is distinct from old.owner_subject_key
    or new.owner_environment_key is distinct from old.owner_environment_key
    or new.registration_sha256 is distinct from old.registration_sha256
    or new.boundary_evaluation_key is distinct from old.boundary_evaluation_key
    or new.registered_at is distinct from old.registered_at
    or new.registrar_role_call_key is distinct from old.registrar_role_call_key
  ) then
    raise exception 'registrar_v1 PAC registered content cannot be mutated in place';
  end if;

  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.c3_pac_free_completeness_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_missing_scope integer;
  v_missing_snapshot integer;
begin
  if new.registration_protocol<>'registrar_v1'
     or new.is_effective is not true
     or new.superseded_at is not null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select count(*) into v_missing_scope
  from public.c3_pac_encounter_scope s
  where s.pac_key=new.pac_key
    and s.standing='active'
    and (
      s.free_call_key is null
      or s.selector_type is null
      or not exists(
        select 1 from public.c3_free_call c
        where c.free_call_key=s.free_call_key and c.standing='active'
      )
    );

  if v_missing_scope>0 then
    raise exception 'registrar_v1 FREE call binding required';
  end if;

  select count(*) into v_missing_snapshot
  from public.c3_pac_encounter_scope s
  join public.c3_free_call c on c.free_call_key=s.free_call_key and c.standing='active'
  where s.pac_key=new.pac_key
    and s.standing='active'
    and c.requires_projection=true
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.c3_free_pac_snapshot fs
      where fs.pac_key=s.pac_key
        and fs.free_call_key=s.free_call_key
        and fs.encounter_key=s.encounter_key
        and fs.standing='active'
        and fs.registration_sha256=new.registration_sha256
    );

  if v_missing_snapshot>0 then
    raise exception 'registrar_v1 FREE projection snapshot required';
  end if;

  return null;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.free_resolve_my_env_current_state_v1(p_session_sha256 text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with owner_context as (
    select ep.envpac_key, ep.env_key
    from public.c3_env_runtime_session s
    join public.c3_envpac ep
      on ep.envpac_key = s.envpac_key and ep.env_key = s.env_key
      and ep.owner_subject_type = s.subject_type and ep.owner_subject_key = s.subject_key
    join public.c3_environment e on e.env_key = ep.env_key and e.is_active
    where s.token_sha256 = p_session_sha256
      and s.standing = 'active' and s.revoked_at is null and s.expires_at > now()
      and ep.is_effective and ep.superseded_at is null and ep.effective_at <= now()
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.c3_envpac_access_grant g
        where g.envpac_key = ep.envpac_key
          and g.subject_type = s.subject_type and g.subject_key = s.subject_key
          and g.relation_role = 'owner' and g.standing = 'active'
          and g.revoked_at is null and (g.expires_at is null or g.expires_at > now())
      )
  ), resolved as (
    select o.envpac_key, w.pac_key as webpac_key, d.pac_key as designpac_key,
           f.free_snapshot_key, f.projection_sha256, f.projection
    from owner_context o
    join public.c3_envpac_presentation e on e.envpac_key = o.envpac_key
      and e.selection_standing = 'active'
    join public.c3_pac w on w.pac_key = e.source_webpac_key and w.envpac_key = o.envpac_key
      and w.pac_type = 'c3WebPac' and w.is_effective and w.superseded_at is null
      and ((w.release_state = 'private' and w.effective_at <= now()) or (
        (w.effective_at is null or w.effective_at <= now())
        and w.pac_key = 'c3webpac_person_eea672f5a7676dad4316755b_v0_1' and o.envpac_key = 'c3envpac_person_eea672f5a7676dad4316755b_v0_1'
        and o.env_key = 'env_person_eea672f5a7676dad4316755b'
        and w.registration_protocol = 'legacy_pre_hardening'
        and w.standing = 'elevated_private_repo_custody_runtime_release_held'
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.measures_persistence_state r
          where r.persistence_key = 'current_state_reconciliation_production_20261120_001:release:personal_webpac_v1'
            and r.oar2_key = 'oar2_current_state_reconciliation_production_20261120_001'
            and r.environment_key = o.env_key and r.object_key = w.pac_key
            and r.object_type = 'owner_private_webpac_presentation_release'
            and r.standing = 'private_presentation_effective'
            and r.source_sha256 = '41d2621a92cc2065fa45c19d54330508de8807ea620c394ccee1e3639e35db39'
            and r.governed_state->>'envpac_key' = o.envpac_key
            and r.governed_state->>'design_registration_sha256' = e.metadata->>'design_registration_sha256'
            and r.governed_state->>'design_pac_key' = e.metadata->>'design_pac_key'
        )
      ))
    join public.c3_pac d on d.pac_key = e.metadata->>'design_pac_key'
      and d.registration_sha256 = e.metadata->>'design_registration_sha256'
      and d.pac_type = 'DesignPac' and d.schema_key = 'pac_schema_designpac_v1_1'
      and d.is_effective and d.superseded_at is null and d.effective_at <= now()
      and d.release_state = 'private' and d.authority_effect = 'none'
    join public.c3_pac_schema ds on ds.schema_key = d.schema_key
      and ds.pac_type = d.pac_type and ds.is_active and ds.standing = 'active'
    join public.c3_free_pac_snapshot f on f.pac_key = d.pac_key
      and f.schema_key = d.schema_key and f.registration_sha256 = d.registration_sha256
      and f.registrar_role_call_key = d.registrar_role_call_key
      and f.standing = 'active' and f.superseded_at is null
      and f.free_call_key = 'my_env_current_state_owner_presentation'
      and f.surface_type = 'my_env' and f.encounter_key = 'my_env_current_state'
      and f.selector_type = 'encounter' and f.selector_value = 'my_env_current_state'
    join public.c3_free_call c on c.free_call_key = f.free_call_key
      and c.call_class = 'environment_projection' and c.surface_class = 'my_env'
      and c.standing = 'active' and c.requires_pac_snapshot and c.requires_projection
    where f.projection_sha256 = encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(f.projection::text, 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex')
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.c3_pac_encounter_scope s
        where s.pac_key = d.pac_key and s.free_call_key = f.free_call_key
          and s.surface_type = f.surface_type and s.encounter_key = f.encounter_key
          and s.selector_type = f.selector_type and s.selector_value = f.selector_value
          and s.standing = 'active'
      )
  )
  select case count(*) when 1 then (jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'standing', 'ACT', 'authority_effect', 'none',
    'envpac_key', envpac_key, 'webpac_key', webpac_key, 'designpac_key', designpac_key,
    'free_snapshot_key', free_snapshot_key, 'projection_sha256', projection_sha256,
    'projection', projection
  ))->0) else jsonb_build_object('standing', 'DNR', 'authority_effect', 'none') end
  from resolved;
$function$

args: p_free_call_key text, p_selector_type text, p_selector_value text
p_presented_pac jsonb, p_boundary_evaluation_key text, p_registrar_role_call_key text, p_source_oar2_ref text
p_presented_pac jsonb, p_boundary_evaluation_key text, p_registrar_role_call_key text, p_source_oar2_ref text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_c3_current(p_env_key text)
 RETURNS TABLE(resolution_standing text, current_state_key text, env_key text, state_version integer, standing text, effective_at timestamp with time zone, predecessor_current_state_key text, source_grammar_key text, evidence_refs jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_env_key is null or length(btrim(p_env_key)) = 0 then
    return query
    select
      'held_missing_env_key'::text,
      null::text,
      null::text,
      null::integer,
      null::text,
      null::timestamptz,
      null::text,
      'codexstone_source_spark_weave_field_form'::text,
      '[]'::jsonb;
    return;
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.c3_current_state s
    where s.env_key = btrim(p_env_key)
      and s.is_current is true
  ) then
    return query
    select
      'held_no_current_state'::text,
      null::text,
      btrim(p_env_key),
      null::integer,
      null::text,
      null::timestamptz,
      null::text,
      'codexstone_source_spark_weave_field_form'::text,
      '[]'::jsonb;
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  select
    'resolved_current_state'::text,
    s.current_state_key,
    s.env_key,
    s.state_version,
    s.standing,
    s.effective_at,
    s.predecessor_current_state_key,
    s.source_grammar_key,
    coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_strip_nulls(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'current_evidence_ref_key', e.current_evidence_ref_key,
            'evidence_key', e.evidence_key,
            'evidence_class', e.evidence_class,
            'asset_key', e.asset_key,
            'content_hash', e.content_hash,
            'hash_algorithm', e.hash_algorithm,
            'custody_type', e.authoritative_custody_type,
            'evidence_standing', e.evidence_standing,
            'tokenization_standing', e.tokenization_standing_at_attest,
            'external_anchor_ref', e.external_anchor_ref_at_attest,
            'source_execution_instance_id', e.source_execution_instance_id,
            'attested_at', e.attested_at
          )
        ) order by e.attested_at, e.current_evidence_ref_key
      ) filter (where e.current_evidence_ref_key is not null),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  from public.c3_current_state s
  left join public.c3_current_evidence_ref e
    on e.current_state_key = s.current_state_key
  where s.env_key = btrim(p_env_key)
    and s.is_current is true
  group by
    s.current_state_key,
    s.env_key,
    s.state_version,
    s.standing,
    s.effective_at,
    s.predecessor_current_state_key,
    s.source_grammar_key;
end;
$function$

args: p_envpac_key text, p_subject_type text, p_subject_key text, p_fields jsonb
p_envpac_key text, p_subject_type text, p_subject_key text, p_display_label text, p_visibility_scope text
